item.tib: ma cig srid pa rgyal mo'i gsang skong mdos gzhung gi stod khrigs
item.coloph: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bkod pa la/ nyes 'gal gyur na mthol bshags 'bul/ dge mchis ma gyur sems can kun/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
